fields.summary_ko.0: ExxonMobil (XOM) closed at an all-time high of $183.21 on October 23, up 52% from the start of the year, exceeding Wall Street's target price of $179.41.
fields.summary_ko.1: Through the Pioneer acquisition, achieved $4 billion in synergy effects, quadrupling the initially expected $2 billion, while pursuing a goal to double the recovery rate in the Permian Basin.
